mode.description: 'edit' = editor with toolbar and Save. 'display' = read-only viewer with folding and search.

language.description: Syntax highlighting + behavior. 'json' adds live parse validation (lint gutter, toolbar badge, output.isValid/errorMessage, Format button).

showToolbar.description: Show the toolbar in edit mode (undo/redo, Format for JSON, Save/Discard).

lineWrapping.description: Soft-wrap long lines instead of horizontal scrolling.

tabSize.description: Indent width in spaces (also the Format indent).

placeholder.description: Hint shown in an empty editor.

locale.description: BCP-47 locale for built-in UI text (en/fr/de/es/nl/it/pt built in). Empty = English.

labels.description: Per-key overrides for built-in UI text. Unset keys follow config.locale (en/fr/de/es/nl/it/pt).

code.description: The document text — the source of truth (bind to a DB column via a named query). Edits stay a local draft until Save fires onSave; write the payload's code back here to complete the round-trip.

output.description: Read-only derived values (describe the BOUND/saved document, not the mid-edit draft).

isDirty.description: True while the editor holds unsaved local edits.

isValid.description: JSON language: whether the bound document parses (empty counts as valid). Always true for other languages. Gate commit buttons on this.

errorMessage.description: The JSON parse error ('' when valid).

lineCount.description: Line count of the bound document.
